# Peoria Spray Foam Pros

## About
Peoria Spray Foam Pros provides professional spray foam insulation for homes and commercial buildings throughout central Illinois. We install both open-cell and closed-cell spray foam in attics, crawl spaces, basement walls, rim joists, and new construction projects. Most residential jobs are completed in a single day.

## Services
- Attic Insulation (open-cell and closed-cell spray foam for improved energy efficiency)
- Crawl Space Insulation (closed-cell spray foam to seal moisture and cold air)
- Basement Wall Insulation (spray foam for cold surfaces, moisture intrusion, and drafts)
- New Construction Insulation (packages for contractors and builders in the Peoria area)
- Commercial Spray Foam (warehouses, agricultural buildings, large commercial properties)
- Open-Cell Spray Foam (cost-effective interior applications)
- Closed-Cell Spray Foam (vapor barrier, structural reinforcement, exterior applications)
- Rim Joist Insulation (sealing the band joist to stop drafts and heat loss)

## Service Area
Peoria, Peoria Heights, East Peoria, Dunlap, Chillicothe, Washington, Morton, Bartonville, Metamora, Peoria County, Tazewell County, Woodford County

## Why Choose Us
Locally operated out of Peoria with eight years in the insulation business. We work directly with homeowners on energy efficiency goals and do not upsell unnecessary product. Spray foam is the correct solution for some situations and not others — we'll tell you honestly which applies to your home.
